Open web steel joists shall comply with Section 1704.2 for special inspection requirements or Section 1704.2.2 when an approved fabricator is used in lieu of special inspections.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
